subject: POC runspace selection & evaluation charter — NovaCare
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@novacare.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: POC runspace selection & evaluation charter — NovaCare

Hi Priya / Arun —

Thanks again for the call today. Putting a concise recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we lock in the kick-off: quick TL;DR, then success criteria, recommended runspace, timeline, and owners.

TL;DR
- We recommend a two-week POC focusing on inference latency/cost and integration with your PHI routing rules.
- Hosting options to choose from: (A) Redwood Hosted (fastest to start), (B) Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPUs, isolated tenancy), (C) VPC trial (private, customer-managed VPC).

Primary success criteria (proposed)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 180ms for 1k token average payload under simulated 5 TPS.
- Cost: per-1k-token inference cost within 20% of Redwood baseline for equivalent quantized model.
- Functional: End-to-end routing through your PHI redaction layer with no dropped requests and validated audit logs.
- Quality: Model response F1 / harm checks on our shared eval set meet your acceptability threshold (precision >= 0.86).

Recommended runspace for this POC
- Start with Redwood Hosted to prove functional integration and run basic load tests (1–3 days).
- If you need network isolation or KMS control for guarded datasets, move to Dedicated sandbox for the remainder (up to 11 days).
- Reserve a VPC path only if audit/regulatory checks require in-VPC processing — we can stage the VPC lift in week 2 if needed.

Proposed timeline & owners
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm runspace choice + sign simple POC MOU (Priya / Sergio).
- Day 1: Provision hosted sandbox + share API keys and network checklist (Redwood infra: Ben).
- Days 2–4: Integration and smoke tests (NovaCare eng: Arun / Redwood: Monica).
- Days 5–10: Load tests and quality evals + cost telemetry (Ben / Monica).
- Day 11–14: Retro + go/no-go and next-step decision (Sergio / Priya).

Open technical asks for kickoff (what we need from you)
- Short sample dataset (10–50 de-identified examples) for evaluation and to seed KV cache behavior.
- Any IP allowlist / egress rules for preliminary hosted testing.
- Confirmation if KMS/HSM controls are required for keys during POC.

Attachments: I attached a one-page mutual action plan (NovaCare-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a lightweight network checklist (poc-network-checklist.pdf) for your infra team.

Next steps (please reply with):
1) Preferred runspace (Hosted / Dedicated sandbox / VPC trial)
2) Contact for infra provisioning (name + email)
3) Preferred kickoff window (we've penciled Nov 17–19)

Happy to hop on a 30-min follow-up if you prefer to talk through the tradeoffs.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

From: Priya Sharma <priya@novacare.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Arun Iyer <arun@novacare.ai>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC runspace selection & evaluation charter — NovaCare

Thanks Sergio — this is helpful and exactly what we need to get unstuck. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We want to start on Redwood Hosted to move quickly but will need to validate that no PHI leaves our project scope. We can use de-identified samples for week 1 and then move to Dedicated sandbox in week 2 if everything looks good.
- KMS: We'll need to use our key management for model artifacts in Dedicated / VPC phases — can you confirm you support customer KMS in Dedicated?
- Evaluation: We'll add a success criterion around "audit trail completeness" — all requests tied to user IDs and exportable logs for a 90-day retention window.

Kickoff window: Nov 17 works for us. Infra contact: Arun Iyer <arun@novacare.ai> (he'll own provisioning).

One more ask: can Redwood provide a short sample ingestion script (python) that shows how the hosted sandbox handles prefix caching and streaming events? Arun will need that for early tests.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Sharma
Head of Data Products | NovaCare
priya@novacare.ai

Sergio / Monica — attaching the updated MAP and a quick infra checklist. I sketched provisioning steps and owner assignments below; happy to adjust if you want different owners.

Provisioning & operational owners (proposed)
- Hosted sandbox (Day 1): Ben to create project, issue API key, enable streaming; share sample ingestion script.
- Dedicated sandbox move (Day 3–4): Monica to coordinate with infra to reserve 1x A100-equivalent pool; enable customer KMS option (if approved).
- Network / Audit (Day 1–2): Ask NovaCare to confirm egress allowlist; Redwood will enable request-level audit logs and provide export.

Quick notes on KMS: Redwood Dedicated supports customer-managed keys via our KMS bridge. We'll need a short KMS onboarding form filled by NovaCare security team (I attached the form inside the MAP tab).

Attachments referenced:
- NovaCare-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP + KMS form)
- poc-network-checklist.pdf (basic egress/allowlist items)

Let me know if you'd like me to run the Nov 17 kickoff — I can lead the tech portion.

—
